audience: developers and operators who run Redis databases on Upstash and check their usage and backups

useCases.title: List databases and check their regions
useCases.text: List the Redis databases of the account with their name, region and state. Read one database to see its plan, endpoint and daily backup setting.

useCases.title: Check the traffic and usage of a cache
useCases.text: Read the usage stats of one database over a time window. Read its traffic time series for the same window.

useCases.title: Review backups and team members
useCases.text: List the backups of one database. List the teams of the account, then the members of one team.

useCases.title: Create a named backup before a migration
useCases.text: Create a named manual backup of one database now. Each call makes a new backup.

useCases.title: Turn daily backups on or off
useCases.text: Turn on daily automatic backups for one database, or turn them off.
